featured_reviews.name: Alric (Alric)
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dont know about the other reviews, but me personally as per my latest visit in January 2025, it was a very disappointing experience and I do not recommend at all if you want a comfortable time gaming.

Very crammed up space, the gaming chairs are broken, cheap peripherals setup. The gaming mouse is the g402 wired, cheap branded keyboard and headsets. Very dark and unhygenic atmosphere, just 1 Fan being pointed towards the reception desk where he works and 1 Air conditioning unit which is not being used to save costs unless the entire cafe is full I'm guessing.

The gaming experience on the PC is decent for now, 240hz monitors available and 3060ti GPU powered PCs.

The chairs are beyond terrible making it very uncomfortable to sit and since it's a very tiny room packed with setups there is barely any space to breathe.

If you're on an extremely tight budget and don't care about comfort, cleanliness and hygiene and just want to enjoy with your friends for the price of 60 rupees an hour, it is not bad for what you get. That's my honest review.

My friends and I recently visited the cafe for a 3 hour gaming session. In my honest opinion the cafe is grossly under-rated. The staff over there genuinely wanting the customers to have a good time. To uphold that thought, they check up on you in almost every half an hour asking if everything is going fine, from the AC temperature to even giving good game tips ; the staff is truly magnificent.

Moving in to the cafe as a whole. It has managed to become a sacred oasis for us gamers in the suburban area. The Mouse (Logitech G 502 - if I'm not mistaken) is smooth like butter, the systems there have the capability to run almost any game you'd like in good quality, I (as a low spec gamer ) really enjoyed the time there. To top it all off the headphones you'd get there are probably the best in all of the area. For 50 rupees an hour this is a really good service.

I majorly recommend the gaming cafe and advise you to make a booking 2 days prior as the staff will update and install any game you ask for.

Much love and hope to visit soon
~ Arco

featured_reviews.name: Guru Gym Foodie
featured_reviews.review_text: 10 pin Bowling in TimeZone. On Thursdays there is a waiting line of 200 people. Waiting time varies from 2 hours to 5 hours. After 4 pm the rate on Thursdays is just Rs.99. But it is amazing how Irshad and Shahid manage the crowd so well. The others too keep the crowd disciplined. I go regularly, so I must say I am impressed with both of them (er, the others I do not remember their names). They encourage me by lauding my bowling and scores. In fact I scored 168 today based on the demo given by Irshad. Amazing how Sky City Mall has become so popular and so crowded. I thank all the staff for their excellent service.

featured_reviews.name: Arshad Ali
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an awesome time at Timezone Sky City! The bowling alley was fantastic—clean, fun, and really well-maintained. The atmosphere was energetic and perfect for a great day out.

A special shout-out to Irsad, who provided exceptional service. He was friendly, helpful, and made the experience even better with his professionalism and positive attitude. Staff like him truly make a difference!

Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for fun activities and great customer service.

If you want it shorter, more formal, or more enthusiastic, just let me know!🤩💯

featured_reviews.name: Om Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very worst experience with the staff and technician team. There was an issue with the game, and when I asked the staff for help, the first response I got was, “Inform the technician, not me.” Amazing customer service standards.

Even after I personally found the technician and explained the issue properly, he barely looked into it. We politely asked for either a refund or at least some game compensation since we had already spent so many points on that game and clearly know how to use it. But instead of helping, the technician arrogantly replied, “Who told you to play this game?” and “Don’t play this game.”

Seriously? Then why keep the game active if customers are not supposed to play it?

We even purchased a Gold Card worth ₹10,000 from the reception, expecting premium service, but instead got rude behavior and zero accountability. Rather than solving the issue, your staff questioned us for playing the game itself. Absolutely unbelievable.

I have visited many Timezone venues like Oberoi, Inorbit, R-City, Capital Mall, Growel’s, etc., and never experienced such pathetic customer service anywhere else. This branch has completely ruined the experience for me and my nephew.

The Venue Head, Prabhat, seriously needs to look into the behavior and attitude of the staff here. Customers are spending money to enjoy, not to get insulted for using the games available at the venue.

Truly disappointing. Negative rating from my side.
